sources.title: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: Reopened on October 27: release history names qwen3-coder-plus and July 22/23 availability, then explicitly describes qwen3-coder-plus-2025-09-23 as its September snapshot with better downstream robustness, tool invocation and code security. It reports no pruning, distillation, expert-count change or additional modality for that update.

sources.title: Qwen3-Coder: Agentic Coding in the World
sources.evidence: Reopened the original July 22, 2025 launch post on October 27. It states 480B total and 35B active parameters for the MoE Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct. The Cline instructions explicitly tell users to configure that named checkpoint through DashScope by entering qwen3-coder-plus. This is a named-model mapping supporting nominal lineage inference, beyond generic family resemblance.

sources.title: Model Studio pricing — historical search-index copy
sources.evidence: Fresh search-index evidence still maps qwen3-coder-plus to qwen3-coder-plus-2025-09-23; the current live pricing page no longer includes the alias. The dated Alibaba update notices s9 and s10 independently establish that mapping without relying only on the stale index.

sources.title: qwen3-coder-plus model card — historical search-index copy
sources.evidence: Indexed exact-model card lists text input/output, Context Window 1000000 and maximum output 65536. Function Calling is supported for China but marked unsupported in international/global sections. Live fetch exceeded the web parser limit; a direct English-page fetch showed redirects to the model overview. Treat the card as historical only.

sources.title: Text generation — historical indexed table and current page
sources.evidence: Search-index copy dated September 11, 2026 lists qwen3-coder-plus with 1M context and supported Thinking mode and Function Calling. Live page updated October 15 omits Plus. The historical thinking claim conflicts with the Dataphin model-specific table.

sources.title: Dataphin built-in model specifications
sources.evidence: Live table identifies qwen3-coder-plus as an Alibaba Cloud Qwen3-based coding/tool-use model and explicitly marks deep thinking unsupported in Dataphin.

sources.title: Announcement: Model retirement for DataWorks Data Agent
sources.evidence: October 8, 2026 announcement lists qwen3-coder-plus among DataWorks models retiring in phases from October 10, with qwen3.7-plus as replacement and region-dependent availability. This does not independently prove every Model Studio endpoint is retired.

sources.title: Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct model card
sources.evidence: Official model overview independently reports 480B total and 35B activated parameters, 62 layers, 160 experts and 8 activated experts. These are developer-published nominal counts for the named model mapped to the hosted alias at launch; no weight shards were downloaded.

sources.title: Model Studio: Update of Qwen3-Coder-Plus, September 28, 2025
sources.evidence: Dated primary notice explicitly maps qwen3-coder-plus from the 2025-07-22 version to the 2025-09-23 version and describes improved downstream-task robustness, function calling and code security. It identifies an update of the same named model, with no disclosed structural change. The 480B/35B carry-forward remains a nominal lineage inference, not a new September count disclosure.

sources.title: Model Studio: Update of Qwen3-Coder-Plus, November 20, 2025
sources.evidence: Reopened primary notice confirms the Beijing and Singapore alias mapping from qwen3-coder-plus-2025-07-22 to qwen3-coder-plus-2025-09-23, scheduled for December 4, 2025. Pricing is unchanged; this corroborates version continuity but is not itself a parameter disclosure.

sources.title: Qwen3-Coder official repository
sources.evidence: Fresh review of the current README finds the open 480B-A35B, 30B-A3B and Next variants. It explicitly attributes the newer Next model to Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Base and its hybrid architecture, but does not map that structural change onto Coder Plus. Targeted English/Chinese searches for the Plus alias and both snapshots found no developer disclosure of a changed total, active count, pruning, distillation or expert expansion.

sources.title: Official Qwen inventory search for the exact hosted model
sources.evidence: The live official organization search returned no checkpoint under the exact hosted model name. Related family releases were checked separately.

sources.title: Official Qwen Qwen3-Coder weight inventory
sources.evidence: The official Qwen organization query returned eight Qwen3-Coder repositories: the 480B and 30B Instruct releases and their FP8 variants, plus Next variants. No separate September 23 checkpoint appears in the returned inventory.

sources.title: Original developer documentation checked for model availability
sources.evidence: The release-history table lists qwen3-coder-plus-2025-09-23 on September 23, 2025 and describes improved downstream robustness, function calling and code security compared with the July 22 version.

name.note: Readable formatting of the official qwen3-coder-plus identifier.

developer.note: Alibaba Cloud documents this Qwen model as its own offering.

family.note: Official release description identifies it as based on Qwen3.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit availability is July 22 in China; international/global service followed July 23.

open_weights.note: The initial Coder-Plus launch used the open 480B checkpoint, but the rolling API alias later changed to the September 23 snapshot. The official released-weight inventory has no corresponding September checkpoint; classify the current hosted revision as closed. Classified closed under the public-download availability rule at review time; an explicit proprietary declaration is not required.

license.note: No weight license established for the exact later hosted alias. Do not transfer an open checkpoint license to an unproven equivalent.

parameters_b.note: Nominal lineage inference: Qwen explicitly maps the hosted alias to Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct at launch, whose developer card reports 480B total. Alibaba identifies September 23 as an update of that same model, with robustness and safety improvements and no disclosed structural change. This supports carrying forward the nominal size; a separate exact September snapshot count was not published.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal lineage inference from the explicitly mapped model: Qwen separately publishes 35B activated parameters. The documented September update contains no changed activation or expert-count specification. Retain the developer activation convention; this is not calculated from total parameters or a claim of exact hosted tensor equivalence.

architecture.note: MoE follows the same explicit launch mapping and documented same-model snapshot update. The base card specifies 160 experts with 8 activated; no structural replacement for Coder Plus was found. The separately named Coder Next architecture is not transferred to Plus.

context_window.note: Last documented exact hosted-card limit is decimal 1,000,000 tokens, correcting 1,048,576. Historical search-index evidence; current endpoint operation was not tested.

modalities.note: Exact hosted model card lists text input and output. Historical documentation only.

reasoning.note: Conflicting primary documentation: indexed Model Studio table says Thinking mode supported; live Dataphin integration says unsupported. Baseline false is not universally established, and the current Model Studio table omits this retired/legacy alias.

tool_call.note: Release history explicitly describes tool calling and the indexed Model Studio table supports it. Historical model card has conflicting regional flags, so this confirms model capability rather than every region or present endpoint.

description.value: Hosted Qwen3 coding model for code generation and tool-driven programming.
description.note: Uses the exact hosted release description without importing open-checkpoint parameter or benchmark claims.

patch.description: Hosted Qwen3 coding model for code generation and tool-driven programming.
patch.notes: Nominal 480B total / 35B active MoE inferred from Qwen’s explicit launch mapping to Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct and the documented September snapshot update; no structural change is disclosed, but the later snapshot has no separate count publication. The current hosted September revision has no identified public weight release; its weight license remains undisclosed. Context and modalities use historical official documentation; current pages omit or redirect this alias, and present endpoint operation is unverified. Official sources conflict on thinking mode and regional tool-calling support. Release date is earliest China availability; international/global service followed July 23. Classified as closed weights: no public release of this hosted variant was found in the developer documentation and weight inventory.

summary: Resolved weight availability. The initial Coder-Plus launch used the open 480B checkpoint, but the rolling API alias later changed to the September 23 snapshot. The official released-weight inventory has no corresponding September checkpoint; classify the current hosted revision as closed. All unrelated field assessments and previous parameter/date evidence are preserved.

accessed_originals.evidence: The live official organization search returned no checkpoint under the exact hosted model name. Related family releases were checked separately.

The official Qwen organization query returned eight Qwen3-Coder repositories: the 480B and 30B Instruct releases and their FP8 variants, plus Next variants. No separate September 23 checkpoint appears in the returned inventory.
The release-history table lists qwen3-coder-plus-2025-09-23 on September 23, 2025 and describes improved downstream robustness, function calling and code security compared with the July 22 version.
Reopened the original Alibaba notice. It schedules the qwen3-coder-plus stable alias to change from qwen3-coder-plus-2025-07-22 to qwen3-coder-plus-2025-09-23 beginning October 22, 2025.
Reopened the original regional notice. It maps qwen3-coder-plus from the July 22 snapshot to the September 23 snapshot in Beijing and Singapore on December 4, 2025.

availability_resolution.rule: Publicly downloadable model weights or explicitly identified equivalent checkpoint => open. No such release found after original documentation and developer inventory checks => closed. API serving extras and weight licenses are separate.
